recentItems.title: AAD Expo | Military and civilian aircraft take centre stage with spectacular aerobatic displays
recentItems.description:
Thousands of aviation enthusiasts are expected to attend the Africa Aerospace and Defence Air Show at the Waterkloof Air Force Base in Pretoria this weekend. 

The show will feature military and civilian aircraft displays, aerobatic performances, and aviation showcases. 

SABC News reporter Patricia Visagie has the latest from the Waterkloof Air Force Base in Pretoria. 

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: EFF vs Mchunu | Rival events heighten tensions across Inanda today
recentItems.description:
Tensions remain high in Inanda today, following clashes between EFF supporters and Ngizwe Mchunu's group yesterday. Police intervened after shots were fired, as both sides prepared for separate events taking place in the area today. The EFF is proceeding with its KwaZulu-Natal manifesto launch, while Mchunu is hosting a heritage and maskandi festival nearby. For the latest, we cross live to SABC News reporter Ayanda Mhlongo in Inanda, north of Durban.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: SABCNews PM Headlines @12H00 | 19 September 2026
recentItems.description:
* Tensions remain high in Inanda following clashes between EFF supporters and Ngizwe Mchunu's supporters.

* President Cyril Ramaphosa has extended the final deadline for the Madlanga Commission of Inquiry to submit its report, to 25 January 2027.

The tournament features the reigning club champions of each of the six FIFA confederations, contested in a knockout format in which the representative from Europe receives a push to the final round.

recentItems.title: EFF vs Mchunu | Tensions escalate ahead of EFF manifesto launch in KZN
recentItems.description:
The EFF is taking its campaign to KwaZulu-Natal today, launching its provincial manifesto ahead of the upcoming local government elections.

It comes after tensions flared between EFF members and organisers of a Maskandi concert in Inanda on Friday. 

Police have since been deployed as a precaution as both events are expected to take place today, just kilometres apart. 

SABC News senior politics reporter Samkele Maseko has the latest from Inanda. 

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: 2026 Africa Aerospace and Defence Exhibition
recentItems.description:
It’s a busy day at the Waterkloof Air Force Base in Pretoria.

The AAD Airshow is already serving a spectacular showcase of military aviation, drawing thousands of spectators to witness cutting-edge aircraft and aerial displays.

It will bring the five-day Africa Aerospace and Defence exhibition to a high-flying finale, highlighting South Africa’s defence capabilities, innovation and aviation industry.

Security is tight, as about 60-thousand people are expected at the airshow. Segomotso Tire from ARMSCOR, one of the main partners, has reminded the Youth to also join the fun.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: LGE 2026 | ATM to reveal mayoral candidates at provincial rally in Bloemfontein
recentItems.description:
The African Transformation Movement (ATM) is holding a provincial rally in Mangaung today, where it is expected to announce its mayoral candidates. 

The rally comes as parties step up their campaigns ahead of the November 4 local government elections. 

SABC News reporter Kamogelo Seekoei reports from Bloemfontein, Free State.

recentItems.title: Ekurhuleni Murders | DA leaders to lay a wreath where one of the victim's body was found
recentItems.description:
DA Leader, Geordin Hill-Lewis will address a public meeting in Kempton Park, following the brutal murders of nine women across Ekurhuleni. 

The DA will engage with residents on the safety challenges facing communities and the steps needed to strengthen protection for women and vulnerable residents across Ekurhuleni. 

Hill-Lewis will be joined by the DA's Ekurhuleni Mayoral Candidate, Khathutshelo Rasilingwane. 

SABC News reporter Pimani Baloyi reports from Kempton Park, Ekurhuleni. 

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: Discussion | GBVF Crisis: Fear grows across communities
recentItems.description:
South Africa is facing another series of deeply disturbing murders in the ongoing gender-based violence crisis and femicide plaguing the nation.

The recent discovery of women's bodies across parts of Gauteng has renewed public concern, grief and calls for urgent action. 

As police investigations continue, questions are once again being raised about the safety of women, accountability, and the country's response to gender-based violence.

Joining us to unpack the crisis, the latest developments, and what needs to change is a panel of guests including Merlize Jogiat from Women For Change, Celeste Louw from the TEARS Foundation, CPF National Spokesperson Siyanda Biyela, and Jade Bernstein, who has a Masters in Forensic Investigative Psychology. 

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: Ekurhuleni Media Briefing | Our goal is to protect the EMPD: Nkosindiphile Xhakaza
recentItems.description:
Ekurhuleni Mayor, Nkosindiphile Xhakaza says they had to follow all processes before they could fire EMPD Deputy Chief, Julius Mkhwanazi. 

Xhakaza says the revelations at the Madlanga Commission in Pretoria has eroded public trust in the Ekurhuleni Metro Police. 

The Mayor says their goal is to protect the EMPD.
